first: # Salisbury Street, Bermondsey. 1851 census, HO107 piece 1560, folio 212.
# TWO CORRECTIONS TO THE 1871 READING. Sarah's birthplace is DEPTFORD, KENT here and
# BERMONDSEY, SURREY in 1871 - a different county, not a variant spelling. And William's
# is WALWORTH, which is compatible with the 1871 NEWINGTON, Walworth being a district
# inside Newington parish, but is the more precise of the two.
# AND IT NARROWS THE MARRIAGE. A son aged 3 in March 1851 puts the wedding BEFORE 1848,
# two years earlier than the 1845-1850 window the archive had been searching.
